inputs.text:
Folks, here we go again. Another public school system brought to its knees, and who pays the price? Our children and our hard-earned tax dollars, that's who. We are looking at a complete failure of basic stewardship in the South Portland School District, which is now facing yet another massive budget shortfall that forces them to slash more than 70 positions from our schools. 

As one local parent and taxpayer rightly put it, it is beyond maddening. For years, we’ve watched bloated bureaucracies and progressive mismanagement prioritize everything except the fundamentals—teaching the basics, respecting parents, and maintaining fiscal sanity. When the people running these institutions can't even balance a budget, they are failing the most basic test of authority and responsibility. 

Instead of focusing on core education and traditional values that build strong communities, these systems crumble under their own weight, leaving families to pick up the pieces. If we don't demand accountability and return to local, sensible stewardship, our children's future will continue to be sacrificed on the altar of administrative waste.
